MockERC20.notes: Standard ERC-20 with public mint(). Test token.

ConfPayToken.notes: ERC-7984 Wrapper. Wraps MockERC20 into confidential token.

PayrollManager_v1.deprecatedReason: ARCH-CHANGE-001: batchPay called Nox.fromExternal internally, causing NotAllowed(bytes32,address) revert due to ACL mismatch in cross-contract handle flow.

PayrollManager_v2.deprecatedReason: Used confidentialTransferFrom external overload but proof validation still failed ('App mismatch' / 'Owner mismatch') due to msg.sender chain in Nox library calls.

PayrollManager_v3.notes: Final architecture: bookkeeping + auditor registry only. Employer calls ConfPayToken.confidentialTransfer directly, then recordPayments here. Auditor ACL via employer's direct NoxCompute.allow calls.

NoxCompute.notes: Not deployed by us. Used for ACL allow/isAllowed and validateInputProof.

employer.notes: Must be contract owner. Must have ≥0.005 ETH + mUSDC.
